title_zh: 把含酒精和无酒精饮料分开放

scenario.label_zh: 核对招待饮料的酒精标签
scenario.goal_zh: 核实饮料是否含酒精，分开摆放并检查标签

context_zh: 两名活动志愿者检查酒会饮料标签，避免把外观相似的饮料混在一起。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Does this fruit punch contain alcohol?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Yes. The plain apple juice is in the other jug.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I was not aware of that. They look almost identical.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Then we should not leave them beside each other without labels.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I will put the alcoholic drinks on the table near the bar and label each jug.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Good. I will keep the juice and water at this end, with clean glasses.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: The labels are on now. Can you check that I have not mixed them up?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: They match the bottles. We are ready to open the doors.
